RECKONING CODE
THE PERPETUAL WAR
THE KOREA NARRATIVE

‘THE WAR 
THAT WASN’T 
DECLARED’

No paperwork ever came.
No declaration.
No vote.
No warning.

Bombs fell anyway.

Children woke to fire.
Fathers ran with rifles
left over from the last war.

They called it a conflict,
a police action,
a skirmish.

But cities burned.
Villages disappeared.
And three million people
stopped breathing.

The language
didn’t match the bodies.

This wasn’t war, they said.
Just stability enforcement.

And so,
without ever naming it,
they made it endless.

It had been done before. 
In Manila. 
In Athens. 
In Jakarta.

Refined here.

It would be done again. 
In Saigon. 
In Baghdad. 
In Kabul.

Justified.
Funded.
Forgotten.

Nais linawin ng MMDA na maaari pa ring manghuli ang mga on-ground traffic enforcers ng ahensiya na naka-deploy sa mga pangunahing lansangan sa Metro Manila.

Kahit umiiral ang No Contact Apprehension Policy (NCAP) ng MMDA, tuloy pa rin ang physical apprehension dahil may mga blind spot areas na walang CCTV cameras. Kinakailangan pa rin itong tauhan ng enforcer upang tiketan ang mga lumalabag sa batas-trapiko.

Tinitiyak ng MMDA na hindi madodoble ang record ng traffic violations ng mga motorista.

Isinusumite ng mga traffic enforcers sa MMDA ang mga traffic violation tickets ng mga nahuli para mai-counter check kung nai-record din ito ng mga camera sa ilalim ng NCAP.
#mmda

data.raw_text:
#news  #géopolitics #The morning brief of the soooo french journalist Shaggy Duck

-------------------------
1 United States
On Monday, Donald Trump stepped up his response to clashes between police and protesters in Los Angeles by deploying Marines for the first time and calling up 2,000 additional National Guard reservists, a reserve force under the joint authority of the states and the federal government. He did so against the advice of the governor of the state concerned, something that had not happened since 1965. These measures have been denounced as disproportionate and illegal by opponents of the US president.
After several days of clashes between law enforcement and protesters opposed to the mass deportation of illegal immigrants, the 78-year-old Republican took the exceptional decision on Monday to deploy 700 active-duty members of this elite corps to the United States. He also ordered the deployment of 2,000 additional members of the National Guard, a reserve force, in addition to the 2,100 already announced in the second-largest US city. On the ground in California, however, tensions appeared to ease somewhat on Monday evening, with incidents becoming more localised. The US president also mentioned the possible deployment of active-duty military personnel in Los Angeles and the use of the army if protests broke out elsewhere in the country, decisions that could create an institutional and political crisis.
‘If we hadn't done that, Los Angeles would have been wiped off the map,’ said the US president, once again attacking California's Democratic governor, Gavin Newsom, and Los Angeles mayor, Karen Bass. ‘They chose to lie to Californians and Americans by saying they didn't need us and talking about “peaceful protests”,’ the president wrote. He said the clashes were the work of ‘professional agitators’ and “insurgents” who ‘should be in jail’. This is not untrue, but to go so far as to consider arresting California Governor Gavin Newsom, as suggested by the White House tenant, Shaggy Duck would venture to observe, ‘Donald, that's civil war rhetoric.’ https://t.co/1eNwqoXimf
--------------------

2 Italy
A referendum in Italy on measures aimed at making it easier to obtain citizenship and revoking labour market liberalisation measures was cut short on Monday due to insufficient voter turnout. According to partial results cited by the media, just under 30% of voters turned out on Sunday and Monday, whereas more than 50% had to vote for the result to be valid. Many members of Giorgia Meloni's nationalist government had called on their supporters to abstain from voting so that the necessary threshold would not be reached.
One of the proposals put forward in this referendum, which was supported by NGOs and opposition parties, was to reduce from ten to five years the length of time that a non-European resident with no marital or blood ties to Italy must have lived in the country before applying for citizenship.
---------------------
3 Trumpism
US Health Minister Robert Kennedy Jr, known for his wild conspiracy theories and, shall we say, original scientific ideas, announced on Monday that he was dismissing all 17 experts from an important advisory group on vaccines, accusing them of conflicts of interest with the pharmaceutical industry, in a further illustration of the White House's vaccine-sceptical stance. Robert Kennedy Jr (RFK) believes that this revision of the panel's composition is essential to restore public confidence. He accuses the group of experts of being compromised by financial ties to pharmaceutical companies.
-----------
4 Ukraine
New ‘massive’ Russian air strikes, the third in a row since the daring Ukrainian drone raid on strategic bombers eight days ago, targeted the Ukrainian cities of Kiev and Odessa on Monday night, killing one person and hitting a maternity hospital, local authorities said. Overall, Moscow's punitive response seems to have fizzled out according to Shaggy Duck.
In central Kiev, at least 12 explosions and anti-aircraft fire were heard. In Russia, where Ukraine is also stepping up drone attacks on strategic infrastructure, 13 airports had to be closed overnight for security reasons, including Moscow's four airports. Meanwhile, Moscow and Kiev have begun the large-scale prisoner exchange promised eight days ago but suspended due to mutual accusations of bad faith.
--------------------
5 Japan
A Chinese aircraft carrier entered Japan's economic waters over the weekend before leaving to conduct exercises involving fighter jets, the Japanese Ministry of Defence said on Monday. The aircraft carrier Liaoning, two missile destroyers and a fast supply ship sailed about 300 km from Japan's easternmost island, Minamitori, on Saturday.
This was the first time a Chinese aircraft carrier had entered this part of Japan's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) in the Pacific Ocean. ‘We believe that the Chinese military is trying to improve its operational capabilities and its ability to conduct operations in remote areas,’ Tokyo said. Shaggy Duck believes that Beijing is becoming increasingly provocative, not only towards the Philippines and Taiwan, but now also towards Japan.
Last September, the aircraft carrier also sailed between two Japanese islands near Taiwan and entered Japan's contiguous zone, an area extending up to 24 nautical miles (approximately 45 km) from its coastline. Under international law, a coastal state exercises rights over resources and economic activities in its EEZ, which extends up to 200 nautical miles (370 km)

Teachers and staff of San Gabriel Elementary School in Macabebe, Pampanga, clean flood-affected school grounds on the second day of Brigada Eskwela on Tuesday, June 10. 

The school has been plagued by decades of flooding due to rising water levels and climate change, making it increasingly difficult for students and teachers to hold classes—especially during typhoon season. 

President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered the rehabilitation of old and dilapidated classrooms, aiming to transform schools into smart, climate-resilient learning facilities. The initiative also seeks to digitally empower teachers and enhance the overall teaching and learning environment for Filipino students. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB

data.raw_text:
Nakiisa ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) sa pangunguna ni MMDA Deputy Chairman Usec. Frisco San Juan Jr. sa Pampamahalaang Programa at Serbisyo na sinimulan sa pamamagitan ng isang ribbon cutting ceremony sa Quirino Grandstand, Manila City para sa pagdiriwang ng Araw ng Kalayaan.

Iba't ibang serbisyo ang alok ng mga ahensiya ng pamahalaan para sa publiko, kasama ang MMDA na nagtayo ng booth na itinatampok ang pitong mandato ng ahensiya; Flood Control and Sewerage Management, Urban Renewal, Zoning and Land Use Planning and Shelter Services, Health and Sanitation, Urban Protection and Pollution Control, Public Safety, Development Planning, Solid Waste Disposal and Management, at Transport and Traffic Management.

Layunin ng mga booths na ito na ilapit sa publiko ang mga serbisyong pang-kalinisan, kalikasan, edukasyon, turismo, negosyo, trabaho, pang-kabuhayan, at marami pang iba.

Mayroon din mga booths na ipinakikita ang tungkol sa kasaysayan, sining at kultura upang kilalanin at ipaalala ang mga sakripisyo na nagbigay-daan sa ating kasarinlan.

#mmda #mmdaatyourservice
